items.text: Has exam season got you hitting the books instead of the gym?
Study is important, but if you're not keeping up with your exercise, you might be missing out.

level1.label: 条件状语从句
level1.text: if you're not keeping up with your exercise

items.text: It turns out that regular physical exercise can boost your memory, focus and reasoning skills.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that regular physical exercise can boost your memory, focus and reasoning skills

items.text: One study even found that Scottish teenagers who got 60 minutes of exercise a day scored a whole grade higher on national exams.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that Scottish teenagers who got 60 minutes of exercise a day scored a whole grade higher on national exams

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: who got 60 minutes of exercise a day

items.text: Physical exercise has been linked to a number of positive changes inside our brains.
Regular aerobic exercise appears to be linked with an enlarged hippocampus.
That's the area of the brain linked to learning and memory.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: the area of the brain linked to learning and memory

items.text: Other studies have suggested that exercise four hours after learning allows new information to be better integrated into our memories.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that exercise four hours after learning allows new information to be better integrated into our memories

items.text: Looking inside our brains, it seems that exercise triggers tiny bursts of electrical energy, known as 'brain ripples' which are thought to be connected to the process of storing and organising memories.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that exercise triggers tiny bursts of electrical energy, known as 'brain ripples' which are thought to be connected to the process of storing and organising memories

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: which are thought to be connected to the process of storing and organising memories

items.text: Exercise could also lead to improved executive function.
This is the part of our brain that's responsible for things including working memory and self-control.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: the part of our brain that's responsible for things including working memory and self-control

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: that's responsible for things including working memory and self-control

items.text: A recent study showed that students who carried out ten minutes of moderate exercise showed improved cognitive performance afterwards.

level1.label: 宾语从句
level1.text: that students who carried out ten minutes of moderate exercise showed improved cognitive performance afterwards

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: who carried out ten minutes of moderate exercise

items.text: As well as the direct physical benefits of exercise on our brains, there are other associated advantages.
Exercise leads to the release of endorphins.
These chemicals help to alleviate the effects of stress and can improve our mood.
Exam preparation can be both a cause of stress and something that's adversely affected by it.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: both a cause of stress and something that's adversely affected by it

items.text: Exercise reduces your stress so that you can focus on your revision.

level1.label: 结果状语从句
level1.text: so that you can focus on your revision

items.text: Good sleep habits are also important for brain health and function.
And this is another area where exercise helps out.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: another area where exercise helps out

items.text: Regular exercise has been shown to lead to better sleep and fewer episodes of insomnia.
A study from the University of Texas also linked it to longer instances of deep sleep.

level1.label: 主语
level1.text: A study from the University of Texas

items.text: When you're asleep, your body processes memories, so it's another way that exercise can take you to higher grades.

level1.label: 表语
level1.text: another way that exercise can take you to higher grades

level2.label: 定语从句
level2.text: that exercise can take you to higher grades

items.text: Exercise benefits both our mental and physical health and has clear benefits for academic performance.

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: both our mental and physical health

items.text: So, while it's important to spend time studying, don't forget to keep some time back for physical activity.

level1.label: 让步状语从句
level1.text: while it's important to spend time studying

level1.label: 宾语
level1.text: to keep some time back for physical activity
